universal.zh: 引擎把燃料的化學能變成旋轉。四行程循環：進氣 → 壓縮 → 爆發 → 排氣。活塞上下動，連桿把它變成曲軸的旋轉，再送去變速箱。幾乎所有燃油車都是這個循環，差別只在缸數、排列與有沒有增壓。
universal.en: The engine turns fuel's chemical energy into rotation. Four strokes: intake, compression, power, exhaust. Pistons move up and down, connecting rods turn that into crankshaft rotation, which goes to the transmission. Nearly every petrol car uses this cycle; only cylinder count, layout and boosting differ.

specific.zh: N20B20 是 2.0 升直列四缸渦輪引擎，用單顆雙渦流渦輪、Valvetronic 可變氣門揚程、直噴與電子水泵。正時鏈在引擎後方靠變速箱那一側，這點和大多數車把正時機構放前面不同。
specific.en: The N20B20 is a 2.0 L inline-four turbo with a single twin-scroll turbo, Valvetronic variable valve lift, direct injection and an electric water pump. Its timing chain sits at the rear of the engine, on the transmission side, unlike most engines that put timing at the front.

fasteners.desc: 引擎腳螺絲 / Engine mount bolts

warnings.zh: 整顆引擎吊出屬於進階作業，需要引擎吊架與支撐橫樑。本模擬器以次總成拆解為主。
warnings.en: Pulling the whole engine is advanced work needing a hoist and support bar. This simulator focuses on sub-assembly teardown.

warnings.zh: 引擎腳在前副車架上，引擎吊出去時從上方解開引擎腳螺絲。
warnings.en: The mounts sit on the front subframe; unbolt them from above as the engine lifts out.

commonIssues.zh: 正時鏈導軌（塑膠）老化碎裂，冷車啟動有咔咔聲；嚴重時鏈條跳齒導致氣門撞活塞。
commonIssues.en: Plastic timing chain guides wear and break up, giving a rattle on cold start; in bad cases the chain jumps and valves hit pistons.

universal.zh: 蓋在缸體上方的鋁合金鑄件，裡面有燃燒室、進排氣道、氣門與凸輪軸。它和活塞頂一起圍成燃燒室，所以缸頭是否平整決定了壓縮會不會漏。
universal.en: The aluminium casting on top of the block holding the combustion chambers, ports, valves and camshafts. Together with the piston crowns it forms the combustion chamber, so a flat head is what keeps compression sealed.

specific.zh: N20 的缸頭整合了 Valvetronic（偏心軸、中間搖臂與馬達）和雙 VANOS。因為正時鏈在後方，拆缸頭前要先把兩顆 VANOS 調節器從凸輪軸上拆下，讓鏈條脫離缸頭。
specific.en: The N20 head carries Valvetronic (eccentric shaft, intermediate levers and motor) plus double VANOS. With the timing chain at the rear, both VANOS units must come off the camshafts first so the chain is free of the head.

fasteners.desc: 缸頭螺絲 / Cylinder head bolts

warnings.zh: 缸頭螺絲是一次性的伸長螺栓，拆下就換新，並且要照順序、分段、加角度鎖緊。
warnings.en: Head bolts are single-use stretch bolts: replace them, and tighten in sequence, in stages, with an angle step.

warnings.zh: 一定要冷車再拆，熱的鋁合金缸頭拆下容易變形。
warnings.en: Only remove it cold; a hot aluminium head can warp.

commonIssues.zh: 過熱後缸頭變形或缸床墊片燒穿：冷卻液減少、排氣冒白煙、冷卻系統有氣泡。
commonIssues.en: Overheating warps the head or blows the gasket: coolant loss, white exhaust smoke, bubbles in the cooling system.

universal.zh: 夾在缸頭和缸體之間的多層鋼片墊片，同時封住燃燒壓力、冷卻液和機油三種東西，讓它們不會互相跑到對方的通道裡。
universal.en: A multi-layer steel gasket clamped between head and block. It seals combustion pressure, coolant and oil at once so none of them leak into the others' passages.

specific.zh: N20 和其他 BMW 鋁合金引擎一樣用多層鋼片（MLS）墊片。拆下後一律換新，接合面要清乾淨但不能刮傷鋁合金。
specific.en: Like other BMW aluminium engines the N20 uses a multi-layer steel (MLS) gasket. Always replace it, and clean the faces without scratching the aluminium.

warnings.zh: 一次性零件，拆下就換新。
warnings.en: Single-use: always replace.

warnings.zh: 不可用金屬刮刀刮鋁合金接合面。
warnings.en: Never scrape the aluminium faces with a metal scraper.

commonIssues.zh: 缸床墊片燒穿：冷卻液不明減少、白煙、機油乳化。
commonIssues.en: Blown head gasket: unexplained coolant loss, white smoke, milky oil.

universal.zh: 蓋在缸頭上方，把凸輪軸與氣門機構罩起來，讓機油留在裡面、灰塵進不去。要碰凸輪軸、正時鏈，第一步都是拆它。
universal.en: Sits on top of the cylinder head, covering the camshafts and valvetrain so oil stays in and dirt stays out. Any work on cams or timing starts by removing it.

specific.zh: N20 的氣門室蓋是塑膠件，曲軸箱通風（PCV）閥與油氣分離功能整合在蓋子裡，所以 PCV 壞了通常要連蓋子一起換。
specific.en: The N20 valve cover is plastic with the crankcase ventilation (PCV) valve and oil separator built in, so a failed PCV usually means replacing the whole cover.

fasteners.desc: 氣門室蓋螺絲 / Valve cover bolts

warnings.zh: 塑膠蓋子怕過度鎖緊，一定要用扭力扳手。
warnings.en: The plastic cover cracks if overtightened; always use a torque wrench.

commonIssues.zh: 蓋子或墊片龜裂漏機油，常見在渦輪側（右側）有燒機油味。
commonIssues.en: Cover or gasket cracks and leaks oil; a burning-oil smell on the turbo (right) side is a common sign.

commonIssues.zh: 內建 PCV 膜片破裂造成怠速不穩、哨音。
commonIssues.en: Built-in PCV diaphragm tears, causing rough idle and a whistling noise.

universal.zh: 引擎最上面那片塑膠蓋，主要是美觀、隔音和擋灰塵，沒有結構功能。大多數車都是用卡扣或橡膠套壓上去，用手往上拔就下來。
universal.en: The plastic cover on top of the engine, mainly for looks, noise and dust; it carries no load. Most cars press it on with clips or rubber grommets, so it pulls straight up by hand.

specific.zh: F30 N20 的飾蓋蓋住考爾那一排。要換火星塞或檢查考爾，第一步就是把它拔起來。
specific.en: On the F30 N20 the cover sits over the row of coils. Pulling it off is step one for a plug change or coil check.

warnings.zh: 往正上方拔，斜拉會把卡扣座拉斷。
warnings.en: Pull straight up; pulling at an angle breaks the clip mounts.

universal.zh: 把 12V 電瓶電壓升到幾萬伏特，送到火星塞打出火花點燃混合氣。每缸一顆直接插在火星塞上（coil-on-plug），所以沒有高壓線。
universal.en: Steps 12 V up to tens of thousands of volts and feeds the spark plug. One coil per cylinder sits directly on the plug (coil-on-plug), so there are no high-tension leads.

specific.zh: N20 四顆考爾排在氣門室蓋正上方，拔掉接頭、拆一顆螺絲就能拿起來，是整顆引擎最容易拆的零件，也是換火星塞的第一步。
specific.en: The four N20 coils sit in a row on top of the valve cover. Unplug the connector, remove one bolt and lift; it is the easiest part on the engine to remove and the first step of a spark-plug change.

fasteners.desc: 考爾固定螺絲 / Coil retaining bolts

warnings.zh: 拔考爾前先把電瓶負極拆掉或至少關閉電門。
warnings.en: Disconnect the battery negative or at least switch off ignition before pulling coils.

commonIssues.zh: 單缸失火（引擎燈閃爍、抖動），常見做法是把可疑考爾和隔壁缸對調看故障碼會不會跟著跑。
commonIssues.en: Single-cylinder misfire (flashing check-engine light, shaking). A common test is swapping the suspect coil with a neighbour and seeing if the fault code moves.

universal.zh: 加機油的蓋子，旋轉一下就打開。蓋子密封不好，曲軸箱會吸進沒過濾的空氣。
universal.en: The cap you add oil through; a twist opens it. If it does not seal, the crankcase draws in unfiltered air.

specific.zh: N20 的加注蓋在氣門室蓋上。F30 沒有機油尺，加完油要用儀表或 iDrive 的油位量測確認。
specific.en: On the N20 the filler is on the valve cover. The F30 has no dipstick, so check the level with the dash or iDrive oil-level measurement after topping up.

universal.zh: 火花跳過電極間隙點燃壓縮後的混合氣。電極會慢慢燒蝕，間隙變大、點火變弱，所以是定期更換的耗材。
universal.en: A spark jumps the electrode gap to ignite the compressed mixture. Electrodes slowly erode, the gap widens and the spark weakens, so plugs are a scheduled consumable.

specific.zh: N20 是渦輪直噴引擎，火星塞在缸頭中央深處、考爾正下方。鎖緊扭力與型號本工具目前標為待查證，請以原廠手冊為準。
specific.en: The N20 is a turbo direct-injection engine; plugs sit deep in the centre of the head, directly under the coils. Torque and plug type are marked unverified here; follow the factory manual.

warnings.zh: 引擎要冷卻後再拆，鋁合金缸頭熱的時候拆火星塞容易傷牙。
warnings.en: Let the engine cool first; removing plugs from a hot aluminium head risks damaging the threads.

warnings.zh: 新火星塞先用手鎖到底再用扭力扳手，避免鎖歪牙。
warnings.en: Thread new plugs in by hand before using the torque wrench to avoid cross-threading.

commonIssues.zh: 老化後冷車失火、油耗變差。
commonIssues.en: Worn plugs cause cold misfires and worse fuel economy.

universal.zh: 把凸輪軸壓在缸頭上的軸承蓋。每個蓋子都和缸頭配對加工，位置和方向不能弄錯。
universal.en: Caps that clamp the camshafts into the head. Each is machined as a pair with the head, so position and direction must not be mixed up.

specific.zh: N20 的凸輪軸蓋要依順序分段放鬆，讓凸輪軸受力均勻，否則凸輪軸可能彎曲。數量與順序以原廠手冊為準（待查證）。
specific.en: Loosen the N20 cam caps gradually in sequence so the camshaft is evenly loaded, or it can bend. Count and sequence per the factory manual (unverified).

fasteners.desc: 軸承蓋螺絲 / Bearing cap bolts

warnings.zh: 拆下前每個蓋子做記號，裝回原位原方向。
warnings.en: Mark every cap before removal and refit it in the same place and direction.

universal.zh: 一根上面有凸輪（桃子形突起）的軸，轉一圈把每顆進氣門推開一次。曲軸轉兩圈，凸輪軸轉一圈，所以由正時鏈以 2:1 帶動。
universal.en: A shaft with egg-shaped lobes; each revolution opens every intake valve once. The crank turns twice for each cam turn, so the timing chain drives it at 2:1.

specific.zh: N20 是雙頂置凸輪（DOHC），進氣凸輪軸後端裝 VANOS 調節器。進氣側另外有 Valvetronic：凸輪不是直接推氣門，而是先推中間搖臂，由偏心軸決定揚程。
specific.en: The N20 is DOHC; the intake camshaft carries a VANOS unit on its rear end. The intake side also has Valvetronic: the lobe pushes an intermediate lever rather than the valve, and the eccentric shaft sets the lift.

warnings.zh: 鬆開凸輪軸前一定要先裝正時鎖定工具。
warnings.en: Always fit the timing lock before releasing the camshafts.

consequence.zh: 沒鎖正時就拆凸輪軸，裝回時正時會錯位，氣門可能撞上活塞。
consequence.en: Removing the cam without locking the timing means it goes back out of time and valves can hit the pistons.

universal.zh: 一根上面有凸輪（桃子形突起）的軸，轉一圈把每顆排氣門推開一次。曲軸轉兩圈，凸輪軸轉一圈，所以由正時鏈以 2:1 帶動。
universal.en: A shaft with egg-shaped lobes; each revolution opens every exhaust valve once. The crank turns twice for each cam turn, so the timing chain drives it at 2:1.

specific.zh: N20 是雙頂置凸輪（DOHC），排氣凸輪軸後端裝 VANOS 調節器。排氣凸輪軸上也有可以鎖正時的定位面（細節待查證）。
specific.en: The N20 is DOHC; the exhaust camshaft carries a VANOS unit on its rear end. The exhaust cam also has flats for the timing lock (details unverified).

warnings.zh: 鬆開凸輪軸前一定要先裝正時鎖定工具。
warnings.en: Always fit the timing lock before releasing the camshafts.

consequence.zh: 沒鎖正時就拆凸輪軸，裝回時正時會錯位，氣門可能撞上活塞。
consequence.en: Removing the cam without locking the timing means it goes back out of time and valves can hit the pistons.

universal.zh: 可變氣門正時：用機油壓力把凸輪軸相對於鏈輪轉一個角度，讓氣門早一點或晚一點打開。低轉要扭力、高轉要馬力，都靠它調。
universal.en: Variable valve timing: oil pressure rotates the camshaft relative to its sprocket so the valves open earlier or later, trading low-rev torque against high-rev power.

specific.zh: BMW 叫它 VANOS。N20 進排氣兩邊都有（雙 VANOS），鏈輪就做在調節器上，所以拆它就等於把正時鏈從凸輪軸上放開。中心螺絲是否一次性與扭力待查證。
specific.en: BMW calls it VANOS. The N20 has it on both cams (double VANOS) and the sprocket is part of the unit, so removing it releases the chain from the camshaft. Whether the central bolt is single-use, and its torque, are unverified.

warnings.zh: 先鎖正時、先放鬆張緊器，再鬆中心螺絲。
warnings.en: Lock the timing and release the tensioner before loosening the central bolt.

warnings.zh: 進氣和排氣的調節器長得像但不能互換，要做記號。
warnings.en: Intake and exhaust units look alike but are not interchangeable; mark them.

consequence.zh: 沒鎖正時就鬆 VANOS，凸輪軸會被氣門彈簧推著轉，正時跑掉，氣門可能撞活塞。
consequence.en: Undoing VANOS without the timing lock lets valve springs rotate the cam; timing is lost and valves can hit the pistons.

commonIssues.zh: VANOS 電磁閥或調節器卡住：引擎燈、怠速不穩、低轉無力。
commonIssues.en: Sticking VANOS solenoid or unit: check-engine light, rough idle, weak low-end.

universal.zh: 可變氣門正時：用機油壓力把凸輪軸相對於鏈輪轉一個角度，讓氣門早一點或晚一點打開。低轉要扭力、高轉要馬力，都靠它調。
universal.en: Variable valve timing: oil pressure rotates the camshaft relative to its sprocket so the valves open earlier or later, trading low-rev torque against high-rev power.

specific.zh: BMW 叫它 VANOS。N20 進排氣兩邊都有（雙 VANOS），鏈輪就做在調節器上，所以拆它就等於把正時鏈從凸輪軸上放開。中心螺絲是否一次性與扭力待查證。
specific.en: BMW calls it VANOS. The N20 has it on both cams (double VANOS) and the sprocket is part of the unit, so removing it releases the chain from the camshaft. Whether the central bolt is single-use, and its torque, are unverified.

warnings.zh: 先鎖正時、先放鬆張緊器，再鬆中心螺絲。
warnings.en: Lock the timing and release the tensioner before loosening the central bolt.

warnings.zh: 進氣和排氣的調節器長得像但不能互換，要做記號。
warnings.en: Intake and exhaust units look alike but are not interchangeable; mark them.

consequence.zh: 沒鎖正時就鬆 VANOS，凸輪軸會被氣門彈簧推著轉，正時跑掉，氣門可能撞活塞。
consequence.en: Undoing VANOS without the timing lock lets valve springs rotate the cam; timing is lost and valves can hit the pistons.

commonIssues.zh: VANOS 電磁閥或調節器卡住：引擎燈、怠速不穩、低轉無力。
commonIssues.en: Sticking VANOS solenoid or unit: check-engine light, rough idle, weak low-end.

universal.zh: 引擎電腦用電磁閥控制送進 VANOS 的機油壓力，決定凸輪軸要往哪個方向轉。電磁閥裡有細小的濾網，機油髒會卡住。
universal.en: The ECU uses solenoid valves to direct oil pressure into the VANOS units and decide which way to turn the cam. They contain fine screens that clog with dirty oil.

specific.zh: N20 進、排氣各一顆。模擬器裡的位置是示意（待查證）。
specific.en: One each for intake and exhaust on the N20. Position in the simulator is schematic (unverified).

warnings.zh: 拔出時會有機油流出。
warnings.en: Oil runs out when they are pulled.

universal.zh: 一般引擎的氣門揚程是固定的，進氣量只能靠節氣門控制，會有「抽氣損失」。可變揚程讓氣門本身決定吸多少空氣。
universal.en: On most engines valve lift is fixed and only the throttle meters air, which costs pumping losses. Variable lift lets the valves themselves decide how much air goes in.

specific.zh: Valvetronic 的偏心軸由馬達轉動，改變中間搖臂的支點，進氣門揚程就能從很小連續調到全開。所以 N20 平常節氣門幾乎全開。
specific.en: Valvetronic's eccentric shaft is turned by a motor and moves the pivot of the intermediate levers, giving continuously variable intake lift from tiny to full. That is why the N20 throttle normally stays almost wide open.

universal.zh: 一顆小型電動馬達，用蝸桿轉動偏心軸，把電腦的指令變成氣門揚程。
universal.en: A small electric motor that turns the eccentric shaft through a worm gear, turning ECU commands into valve lift.

specific.zh: 裝在 N20 缸頭進氣側。拆下後偏心軸要做初始化（學習），通常需要診斷電腦。
specific.en: Mounted on the intake side of the N20 head. After removal the eccentric shaft position must be re-learned, usually with a diagnostic tool.

warnings.zh: 拆裝後需要用診斷電腦學習偏心軸位置。
warnings.en: A diagnostic tool is needed to re-learn the eccentric shaft position afterwards.

commonIssues.zh: 馬達或感知器故障：引擎燈、怠速不穩，引擎會退回用節氣門控制。
commonIssues.en: Motor or sensor failure: check-engine light, rough idle; the engine falls back to throttle control.

universal.zh: 凸輪推搖臂、搖臂再推氣門。液壓頂桿用機油自動吃掉間隙，所以不用定期調氣門間隙。
universal.en: The cam pushes the rocker, which pushes the valve. Hydraulic lifters take up clearance with oil pressure, so no periodic valve adjustment is needed.

specific.zh: N20 進氣側多了 Valvetronic 中間搖臂，排氣側是一般滾子搖臂。每支搖臂都要放回原本的氣門上。
specific.en: The N20 intake side adds Valvetronic intermediate levers; the exhaust side uses ordinary roller rockers. Every rocker must go back on its own valve.

warnings.zh: 拆下的搖臂依序排好，不可混放。
warnings.en: Lay rockers out in order; never mix them.

universal.zh: 每缸兩進兩排共四顆氣門，像門一樣讓空氣進來、廢氣出去。彈簧把氣門拉回關閉，凸輪負責推開。
universal.en: Four valves per cylinder, two intake and two exhaust, let air in and exhaust out. Springs pull them shut; the cam pushes them open.

specific.zh: N20 四缸共 16 顆氣門。拆氣門要用彈簧壓縮器取出氣門夾，屬於缸頭翻修等級的工作。
specific.en: The N20 has 16 valves. Removing them needs a spring compressor to free the collets; this is head-rebuild level work.

warnings.zh: 氣門油封拆下要換新。
warnings.en: Valve stem seals must be replaced once removed.

commonIssues.zh: 氣門油封老化造成冷車冒藍煙、吃機油。
commonIssues.en: Worn valve stem seals cause blue smoke on cold start and oil consumption.

universal.zh: 直噴引擎要把汽油直接噴進汽缸，壓力比傳統噴射高很多，所以油箱泵送來的油要再經過一顆機械高壓泵加壓。
universal.en: A direct-injection engine sprays fuel straight into the cylinder at far higher pressure than port injection, so fuel from the tank pump goes through a mechanical high-pressure pump.

specific.zh: N20 的高壓油泵由凸輪軸上的凸輪驅動。實際裝在缸頭的哪個位置，模擬器目前是示意（待查證）。
specific.en: The N20 HPFP is driven by a lobe on a camshaft. Its exact position on the head is schematic in the simulator (unverified).

warnings.zh: 拆任何高壓油路前，先讓油壓洩掉，引擎冷卻後再動。
warnings.en: Let fuel pressure bleed off and the engine cool before opening any high-pressure line.

commonIssues.zh: 高壓油泵故障：加速無力、啟動困難、低油壓故障碼。
commonIssues.en: HPFP failure: poor acceleration, hard starting, low fuel pressure codes.

universal.zh: 連接高壓油泵和油軌的鋼管。接頭是金屬對金屬密封，所以鎖緊扭力很重要。
universal.en: The steel pipe from the high-pressure pump to the rail. The fittings seal metal to metal, so torque matters.

specific.zh: N20 的高壓油管接頭是否需要換新，以原廠手冊為準（待查證）。
specific.en: Whether the N20 HP line must be replaced after removal: follow the factory manual (unverified).

warnings.zh: 高壓油管不可彎折。
warnings.en: Never bend the high-pressure line.

universal.zh: 油軌像一條高壓水管，把油分給每缸的噴油嘴。電腦用通電時間長短決定噴多少油。
universal.en: The rail is a pressurised manifold feeding each injector. The ECU sets how much fuel is sprayed by how long it energises each injector.

specific.zh: N20 是缸內直噴，噴油嘴裝在缸頭進氣側，被進氣歧管擋住，所以要先拆歧管。噴嘴的鐵氟龍密封環拆下要換新。
specific.en: The N20 is direct-injected; the injectors sit on the intake side of the head behind the manifold, so the manifold comes off first. The Teflon sealing rings must be replaced.

warnings.zh: 噴油嘴密封環一次性。
warnings.en: Injector seals are single-use.

warnings.zh: 拆下後堵住噴嘴孔，避免異物掉進汽缸。
warnings.en: Plug the injector bores so nothing falls into the cylinders.

commonIssues.zh: 噴油嘴漏油或霧化不良：失火、冷車抖動。
commonIssues.en: Leaking or poorly atomising injectors: misfires and cold-start shake.

universal.zh: 一個大氣室（plenum）加四根管子，把空氣平均分給四個汽缸。管子的長度與粗細會影響引擎在哪個轉速最有力。
universal.en: A plenum chamber plus four runners that share air evenly between the cylinders. Runner length and diameter shape where in the rev range the engine pulls hardest.

specific.zh: N20 的歧管是塑膠件，裝在引擎左側（駕駛座側）。因為有 Valvetronic 用氣門揚程控制進氣量，正常行駛時節氣門幾乎全開，歧管內的真空比傳統引擎小很多。
specific.en: The N20 manifold is plastic, on the left (driver's) side. Because Valvetronic meters air with valve lift, the throttle stays nearly wide open in normal driving, so manifold vacuum is much lower than on a conventional engine.

fasteners.desc: 歧管固定螺絲 / Manifold bolts

warnings.zh: 拆下後用布堵住缸頭進氣口，掉一顆螺絲進去就是拆缸頭。
warnings.en: Plug the head's intake ports with rags once the manifold is off; a dropped bolt means pulling the head.

universal.zh: 一片圓形蝶閥，油門踩多深它就開多大，決定多少空氣進引擎。現代車都是電子節氣門：油門踏板只是個感知器，由電腦控制馬達開閥。
universal.en: A round butterfly valve that opens with the accelerator and decides how much air enters. Modern cars use drive-by-wire: the pedal is just a sensor and the ECU drives a motor to open the valve.

specific.zh: 在 N20 上節氣門鎖在進氣歧管前端，但因為 Valvetronic 接手了大部分的進氣量控制，它平常幾乎全開，主要負責怠速、緊急模式與製造煞車倍力器需要的真空。
specific.en: On the N20 the throttle bolts to the front of the intake manifold, but since Valvetronic handles most air metering it stays nearly open, mainly covering idle, limp mode and brake-booster vacuum.

fasteners.desc: 節氣門固定螺絲 / Throttle body bolts

warnings.zh: 不要用手硬扳蝶閥，齒輪會壞。
warnings.en: Never force the butterfly by hand; the gear train breaks.

commonIssues.zh: 積碳造成怠速不穩，清潔後需重新學習（適應值歸零）。
commonIssues.en: Carbon build-up causes rough idle; after cleaning, adaptations need resetting.

universal.zh: 把過濾後的乾淨空氣從空濾盒送到渦輪的壓縮端。這段管子在渦輪前面，所以是負壓；破了會吸進沒過濾的空氣。
universal.en: Carries filtered air from the airbox to the turbo compressor. It is upstream of the turbo, so under slight vacuum; a crack lets unfiltered air in.

specific.zh: F30 N20 的進氣管從引擎左前方的空濾盒，跨過引擎前端接到右側的渦輪。模擬器裡的走向是示意。
specific.en: On the F30 N20 it runs from the airbox at the front left, across the front of the engine, to the turbo on the right. The routing here is schematic.

universal.zh: 引擎吸進的所有空氣都先經過這裡。盒子裡的濾芯擋住灰塵，灰塵進引擎會磨損汽缸。
universal.en: All the air the engine breathes passes through here first. The filter element inside stops dust that would otherwise wear the cylinders.

specific.zh: 裝在 F30 引擎室左前方，上蓋用螺絲固定。
specific.en: Sits at the front left of the F30 engine bay with a screwed lid.

universal.zh: 紙質濾芯，定期更換的耗材。太髒會讓進氣阻力變大、油耗變差。
universal.en: A paper element; a scheduled consumable. A dirty one restricts airflow and worsens fuel economy.

specific.zh: 打開空濾盒上蓋就能換。台灣灰塵多、走走停停，建議比原廠週期早一點檢查（「保養」分頁分開標示原廠與保守建議）。
specific.en: Open the airbox lid to change it. With Taiwan's dust and stop-go traffic, check it earlier than the factory interval (the Maintenance tab lists both).

name.zh: 雙渦流渦輪（含排氣歧管）

universal.zh: 排氣吹動渦輪葉片，同軸的壓縮葉片把更多空氣壓進引擎，所以小排氣量也能有大馬力。壓過的空氣會變熱，所以要經過中冷器降溫。
universal.en: Exhaust gas spins a turbine; a compressor on the same shaft forces more air into the engine, so a small engine can make big power. Compressed air gets hot, hence the intercooler.

specific.zh: N20 用一顆雙渦流（twin-scroll）渦輪：1-4 缸和 2-3 缸的排氣分成兩條通道進渦輪，減少排氣脈衝互相干擾，低轉就能起壓。排氣歧管和渦輪殼做成一體，直接鎖在缸頭右側（副駕駛座側）。
specific.en: The N20 uses one twin-scroll turbo: exhaust from cylinders 1-4 and 2-3 enters through separate passages so pulses do not fight each other, giving boost at low rpm. The exhaust manifold is cast into the turbine housing and bolts straight to the right (passenger) side of the head.

fasteners.desc: 渦輪對缸頭螺帽 / Turbo-to-head nuts
機油進油管與回油管 / Oil feed & return lines

warnings.zh: 拆渦輪要先放冷卻液（渦輪有水冷管路）並拆隔熱板。
warnings.en: Drain coolant first (the turbo is water-cooled) and remove heat shields.

warnings.zh: 裝回時機油進油管要先灌油，乾轉會燒軸承。
warnings.en: Prime the oil feed line on reinstall; a dry start wrecks the bearing.

warnings.zh: 實車還要先拆排氣前段（P4 加入後補上相依）。
warnings.en: On the real car the front exhaust section comes off first (dependency added in P4).

commonIssues.zh: 洩壓閥（wastegate）連桿鬆動造成金屬咔咔聲。
commonIssues.en: Wastegate linkage rattle (metallic ticking).

universal.zh: 渦輪轉太快壓力會太高，洩壓閥打開讓一部分排氣繞過渦輪，用來控制增壓值。
universal.en: Left alone the turbo would overboost; the wastegate opens to send some exhaust around the turbine and so controls boost.

specific.zh: N20 的洩壓閥做在渦輪殼上，跟著渦輪一起拆下。致動方式（真空或電子）待查證。
specific.en: On the N20 the wastegate is built into the turbine housing and comes off with the turbo. Whether the actuator is vacuum or electric is unverified.

commonIssues.zh: 洩壓閥連桿鬆動：冷車或鬆油門時有金屬咔咔聲。
commonIssues.en: Loose wastegate linkage: metallic rattle on cold start or lift-off.

universal.zh: 包在渦輪外面的金屬板，擋住幾百度的熱輻射，保護旁邊的線束和塑膠件。
universal.en: A metal shield around the turbo that blocks radiant heat of several hundred degrees, protecting nearby wiring and plastics.

specific.zh: 拆 N20 渦輪的第一步。螺絲常常鏽死，先噴除鏽劑。
specific.en: Step one for an N20 turbo job. The bolts are often seized; soak them in penetrating oil first.

universal.zh: 渦輪壓出來的熱空氣，經這組管子送到中冷器降溫，再回到節氣門。這段是正壓，漏氣會讓增壓上不去。
universal.en: Hot air from the turbo goes through these pipes to the intercooler and back to the throttle. They are under boost, so a leak means lost boost.

specific.zh: F30 N20 的增壓管有塑膠段，卡扣式接頭。模擬器把兩段畫成一組。
specific.en: On the F30 N20 parts of the charge piping are plastic with clip fittings. The simulator shows both sections as one group.

commonIssues.zh: 塑膠增壓管或接頭破裂：加速時有洩氣聲、無力、增壓不足故障碼。
commonIssues.en: Cracked plastic charge pipe or fitting: hissing under boost, loss of power, underboost codes.

universal.zh: 空氣被壓縮會變熱，熱空氣密度低、也容易爆震。中冷器像一個空氣用的水箱，讓迎面風把增壓空氣降溫。
universal.en: Compressed air gets hot; hot air is less dense and invites knock. The intercooler is an air-to-air radiator cooled by oncoming air.

specific.zh: F30 的中冷器在保險桿後面、水箱下方前方。實車要先拆前保險桿（P4 加入後補上相依）。
specific.en: On the F30 it sits behind the bumper, low and ahead of the radiator. The real job needs the front bumper off first (added in P4).

universal.zh: 用機油壓力和彈簧把張緊軌壓向鏈條，讓鏈條保持緊度。鏈條拉長時，它會越推越出來。
universal.en: Uses oil pressure and a spring to press the tensioner rail against the chain to keep it tight. As the chain stretches, it extends further.

specific.zh: N20 正時鏈在引擎後方，張緊器也在後方。拆下時有機油流出。
specific.en: The N20 chain is at the rear of the engine, and so is the tensioner. Oil runs out when it is removed.

warnings.zh: 張緊器的密封墊片要換新。
warnings.en: Replace the tensioner sealing washer.

universal.zh: 曲軸和凸輪軸必須永遠保持固定的角度關係（正時），鏈條就是把兩者綁在一起的東西。跳一齒，氣門就可能撞活塞。
universal.en: Crank and cams must always keep a fixed angular relationship (timing), and the chain is what ties them together. Jump one tooth and the valves can hit the pistons.

specific.zh: N20 的正時鏈在引擎後方、靠變速箱那一側，所以實車換正時鏈通常要先拆變速箱，或把引擎吊出來。這是 N20 最有名的大工程。
specific.en: The N20 chain is at the rear, on the transmission side, so a real chain job usually means removing the gearbox or pulling the engine. It is the N20's best-known big job.

warnings.zh: 正時鏈蓋在飛輪後面，所以要先拆變速箱、離合器與飛輪（自排則是驅動盤）才碰得到。
warnings.en: The timing cover sits behind the flywheel, so the gearbox, clutch and flywheel (or the flexplate on an automatic) come off first.

warnings.zh: 換鏈條時導軌、張緊器一起換。
warnings.en: Replace the guides and tensioner along with the chain.

commonIssues.zh: 正時鏈拉長或導軌碎裂：冷車啟動有咔咔、嗡嗡聲。
commonIssues.en: Stretched chain or broken guides: rattle or whine on cold start.

universal.zh: 塑膠導軌讓鏈條沿著固定路線走、不亂甩。一邊是固定導軌，另一邊是被張緊器推著的張緊軌。
universal.en: Plastic guides keep the chain on a fixed path. One side is a fixed guide; the other is the tensioner rail pushed by the tensioner.

specific.zh: N20 早期的塑膠導軌容易老化碎裂，碎片可能堵住機油吸油網。這是 N20 最常被討論的毛病。
specific.en: Early N20 plastic guides can age and break, and fragments can block the oil pickup screen. This is the most discussed N20 issue.

commonIssues.zh: 導軌碎裂：冷車咔咔聲，碎片掉進油底殼。
commonIssues.en: Broken guides: cold-start rattle and debris in the oil pan.

universal.zh: 引擎最底下的油槽，機油流回這裡，再由機油泵抽上去潤滑。換機油的洩油螺絲就在它底部。
universal.en: The reservoir at the bottom of the engine; oil drains back here and the pump draws it up again. The drain plug for an oil change is on its underside.

specific.zh: F30 沒有機油尺，油量靠油底殼裡的電子油位感知器，從儀表看。所以油底殼除了洩油螺絲還有一個感知器與線束。
specific.en: The F30 has no dipstick; oil level comes from an electronic sensor in the pan and is read on the dash. So besides the drain plug the pan carries a level sensor and its wiring.

fasteners.desc: 油底殼螺絲 / Oil pan bolts

warnings.zh: 拆油底殼通常要先拆前副車架或把引擎稍微吊起，這在模擬器裡簡化掉了。
warnings.en: Removing the pan usually needs the front subframe dropped or the engine lifted slightly; the simulator simplifies this.

commonIssues.zh: 油底殼墊片滲油。
commonIssues.en: Oil pan gasket seepage.

universal.zh: 量油底殼裡的機油高度和溫度，取代傳統的機油尺。
universal.en: Measures oil level and temperature in the sump, replacing the traditional dipstick.

specific.zh: F30 沒有機油尺，油量完全靠這顆感知器，從儀表或 iDrive 看。裝在油底殼底部，跟著油底殼一起下來。
specific.en: The F30 has no dipstick; oil level comes only from this sensor, shown on the dash or iDrive. It sits in the bottom of the pan and comes off with it.

commonIssues.zh: 感知器故障：儀表顯示油位異常或無法量測。
commonIssues.en: Sensor failure: wrong or unavailable oil-level reading.

universal.zh: 把油底殼的機油抽上來加壓，送到曲軸、凸輪軸、渦輪、VANOS。機油壓力沒了，引擎幾秒鐘就會受損。
universal.en: Draws oil from the sump and pressurises it to the crank, cams, turbo and VANOS. Lose oil pressure and the engine is damaged within seconds.

specific.zh: N20 的機油泵是可變排量，由曲軸用鏈條驅動。和平衡軸的實際配置模擬器裡是示意（待查證）。
specific.en: The N20 oil pump is variable-displacement and chain-driven from the crank. Its exact layout with the balance shafts is schematic here (unverified).

universal.zh: 機油泵的「吸管」，前端有濾網擋住大顆碎片。濾網被堵住，機油壓力會下降。
universal.en: The oil pump's straw, with a screen at its tip to catch large debris. A clogged screen drops oil pressure.

specific.zh: N20 導軌碎片最怕掉到這裡。換正時鏈時順便檢查濾網。
specific.en: This is where broken N20 guide fragments do the most harm. Inspect the screen during a chain job.

universal.zh: 直列四缸天生有二階振動，兩根以兩倍曲軸轉速反向旋轉的配重軸可以把它抵消，讓引擎更安靜平順。
universal.en: An inline-four has inherent second-order vibration. Two weighted shafts spinning in opposite directions at twice crank speed cancel it for a smoother, quieter engine.

specific.zh: N20 有平衡軸，裝在缸體下方。驅動方式與位置在模擬器裡是示意（待查證）。
specific.en: The N20 has balance shafts below the block. Their drive and position here are schematic (unverified).

universal.zh: 把曲軸壓在缸體上的蓋子，裡面夾著軸承（大瓦）。每個蓋子和缸體一起加工，不能換位置。
universal.en: Caps that clamp the crankshaft into the block, holding the main bearing shells. Each is machined with the block and must stay in its position.

specific.zh: 螺絲數量、是否一次性、扭力加角度都以原廠手冊為準（待查證）。
specific.en: Bolt count, single-use status and torque-plus-angle per the factory manual (unverified).

fasteners.desc: 主軸承蓋螺絲 / Main cap bolts

warnings.zh: 依序做記號，原位原方向裝回。
warnings.en: Mark them in order and refit in the same place and direction.

universal.zh: 活塞被燃燒壓力往下推，連桿把直線運動變成曲軸的旋轉。四行程裡活塞上下各兩次，曲軸轉兩圈完成一個循環。
universal.en: Combustion pressure pushes the piston down and the rod turns that into crank rotation. In four strokes the piston goes up and down twice and the crank turns twice per cycle.

specific.zh: N20 缸徑 84.0 mm、行程 90.1 mm（見引擎總成規格）。拆活塞要從缸頂抽出，所以要先拆缸頭與油底殼（從下方鬆連桿蓋）。
specific.en: The N20 has an 84.0 mm bore and 90.1 mm stroke (see engine specs). Pistons come out the top, so the head comes off first, and the pan so the rod caps can be undone from below.

warnings.zh: 連桿螺絲通常是一次性（待查證），連桿蓋不可互換。
warnings.en: Rod bolts are usually single-use (unverified); rod caps are not interchangeable.

warnings.zh: 裝回要用活塞環壓縮器，敲進去前確認環口錯開。
warnings.en: Use a ring compressor on refit and stagger the ring gaps first.

universal.zh: 引擎的輸出軸。每缸一個偏心的曲柄，把活塞的上下運動變成旋轉，再經飛輪送到變速箱。
universal.en: The engine's output shaft. An offset crank throw per cylinder turns piston motion into rotation, which goes through the flywheel to the gearbox.

specific.zh: 拆到這裡就是整顆 N20 的最底層。後端驅動正時鏈，前端裝減震皮帶盤。
specific.en: This is the bottom of the N20 teardown. The rear end drives the timing chain and the front carries the vibration damper.

warnings.zh: 曲軸後端法蘭鎖著飛輪（手排）或驅動盤（自排），要先拆掉。
warnings.en: The flywheel (manual) or flexplate (automatic) bolts to the rear flange and comes off first.

universal.zh: 曲軸前端的皮帶盤，內圈與外圈之間夾一層橡膠，吸收曲軸的扭轉振動，同時帶動附件皮帶。
universal.en: The pulley on the crank nose. A rubber layer between inner and outer rings absorbs torsional vibration while it drives the accessory belt.

specific.zh: N20 的中心螺絲扭力很大、是否一次性待查證。模擬器裡拆它是為了能拿出曲軸。
specific.en: The N20 central bolt is very tight; whether it is single-use is unverified. Here it comes off so the crank can come out.

warnings.zh: 橡膠層龜裂或外圈偏擺就要換。
warnings.en: Replace it if the rubber is cracked or the outer ring wobbles.

universal.zh: 一條多溝皮帶（蛇形皮帶）由曲軸帶動發電機、冷氣壓縮機等附件。斷了發電機就不發電。
universal.en: A multi-rib (serpentine) belt driven by the crank turns the alternator, A/C compressor and other accessories. If it snaps, the alternator stops charging.

specific.zh: N20 是電子水泵，所以皮帶不帶水泵，斷了不會馬上過熱，但會沒有發電。
specific.en: The N20 water pump is electric, so the belt does not drive it; a snapped belt will not overheat the engine at once, but charging stops.

warnings.zh: 拆前先拍照記住繞法。
warnings.en: Photograph the routing before removal.

commonIssues.zh: 皮帶龜裂、吱吱叫；機濾座漏油滴到皮帶會加速損壞，嚴重時皮帶被捲進前油封。
commonIssues.en: Cracked or squealing belt. Oil from a leaking filter housing degrades it, and in bad cases a shredded belt gets pulled into the front seal.

universal.zh: 用彈簧把一個惰輪壓向皮帶，讓皮帶保持張力。
universal.en: A spring-loaded idler pulley that keeps the belt under tension.

specific.zh: 換皮帶時用套筒把張緊器扳開就能鬆皮帶。
specific.en: Lever the tensioner back with a socket to slacken the belt.

universal.zh: 引擎運轉時發電，供應全車用電並把電瓶充回來。
universal.en: Generates electricity while the engine runs, powering the car and recharging the battery.

specific.zh: F30 有智慧充電管理，換電瓶後要註冊（說明在「保養」分頁的電瓶項目）。
specific.en: The F30 uses intelligent charging; a new battery must be registered (see the Battery item in the Maintenance tab).

warnings.zh: 先拆電瓶負極（F30 電瓶在後車廂）。
warnings.en: Disconnect the battery negative first (the F30 battery is in the trunk).

universal.zh: 把冷媒壓縮成高壓高溫氣體，是冷氣循環的心臟。
universal.en: Compresses refrigerant into hot high-pressure gas; the heart of the A/C circuit.

specific.zh: 拆冷氣管之前冷媒必須由合格設備回收，不可直接排放。
specific.en: Refrigerant must be recovered with proper equipment before opening the lines; never vent it.

warnings.zh: 冷媒要用回收機回收，直接排放違法也傷皮膚眼睛。
warnings.en: Recover refrigerant with a machine; venting is illegal and harms skin and eyes.

consequence.zh: 冷媒沒回收就拆管路：高壓冷媒噴出會凍傷、傷眼，而且排放冷媒違法。
consequence.en: Opening the lines without recovering the refrigerant: it sprays out under pressure, can freeze skin and eyes, and venting it is illegal.

universal.zh: 鑰匙一轉，起動馬達的小齒輪咬進飛輪齒圈，把引擎轉起來直到它自己會跑。
universal.en: Turn the key and the starter pinion engages the flywheel ring gear, cranking the engine until it runs on its own.

specific.zh: N20 的起動馬達在進氣歧管下方，所以要先拆歧管才拿得到。這是「被擋住但沒有裝在一起」的例子。
specific.en: On the N20 the starter sits under the intake manifold, so the manifold comes off first. A good example of a part that is blocked by, not mounted on, another.

warnings.zh: 先拆電瓶負極；起動馬達主線是不經保險絲的粗線。
warnings.en: Disconnect the battery first; the starter main cable is unfused.

universal.zh: 讀曲軸上的齒盤，告訴電腦現在轉速與活塞在哪裡，噴油和點火都靠它。壞了引擎會發不動或突然熄火。
universal.en: Reads a toothed wheel on the crank to tell the ECU speed and piston position; fuel and spark timing depend on it. When it fails the engine will not start or cuts out.

specific.zh: 模擬器裡的位置是示意（待查證）。
specific.en: Position in the simulator is schematic (unverified).

universal.zh: 把冷卻水推過引擎水道和水箱，把熱帶走。傳統水泵靠皮帶轉，引擎轉多快它就轉多快。
universal.en: Pushes coolant through the engine's water jackets and the radiator to carry heat away. A conventional pump is belt-driven, so it spins with engine speed.

specific.zh: N20 用電子水泵，不靠皮帶，由引擎電腦依溫度決定轉速，冷車時可以少轉讓引擎快點熱，熄火後還能繼續轉幫渦輪散熱。缺點是它是電子件，壞了通常直接換整顆。
specific.en: The N20 uses an electric pump: no belt, the ECU sets its speed by temperature. It can slow down on a cold engine for faster warm-up and keep running after shutdown to cool the turbo. Downside: it is electronic, and when it fails the whole unit is replaced.

fasteners.desc: 水泵固定螺絲 / Pump mounting bolts

warnings.zh: 先放冷卻液；裝回後要用真空加注器排空氣，否則會有氣鎖造成過熱。
warnings.en: Drain coolant first; after reinstalling, vacuum-fill to purge air or an airlock will cause overheating.

commonIssues.zh: 水泵故障會跳「冷卻系統」警示並進入保護模式，常和節溫器一起換。
commonIssues.en: Pump failure triggers a cooling-system warning and limp mode; commonly replaced together with the thermostat.

universal.zh: 冷車時關閉，讓冷卻液只在引擎內循環，快點熱車；熱了才打開讓水去水箱散熱。
universal.en: Stays shut when cold so coolant circulates only in the engine and it warms up fast; opens when hot to send coolant to the radiator.

specific.zh: BMW 用電子節溫器（內有加熱元件），電腦可以讓它提早打開，例如高負載時先把溫度降下來。
specific.en: BMW uses an electrically heated thermostat, so the ECU can open it early, for example to drop temperature under high load.

warnings.zh: 裝回後要真空加注排空氣。
warnings.en: Vacuum-fill to purge air afterwards.

commonIssues.zh: 節溫器卡在開：熱車慢、暖氣不熱；卡在關：過熱。
commonIssues.en: Stuck open: slow warm-up, weak heater. Stuck shut: overheating.

universal.zh: 連接引擎、節溫器、水泵、水箱的橡膠管。老化會變硬龜裂。
universal.en: Rubber hoses linking engine, thermostat, pump and radiator. They harden and crack with age.

specific.zh: BMW 的水管多用卡扣式快速接頭，用撬棒輕壓卡扣就能拔。模擬器把主要水管畫成一組。
specific.en: BMW uses clip-type quick connectors; release the clip gently with a pry tool. The simulator groups the main hoses.

warnings.zh: 冷車才能開冷卻系統，熱的時候有壓力會噴出。
warnings.en: Only open the cooling system cold; it is pressurised when hot.

universal.zh: 冷卻液流過細小的鰭片管，被迎面風和風扇吹涼，把引擎的熱散到空氣中。
universal.en: Coolant flows through finned tubes and is cooled by oncoming air and the fan, dumping engine heat to the atmosphere.

specific.zh: F30 的水箱在中冷器後方，電子風扇裝在水箱後面。在模擬器裡要先單獨拆風扇（風扇不會跟著水箱一起走）。
specific.en: On the F30 the radiator sits behind the intercooler with the electric fan behind it. In the simulator the fan must come off separately first (it does not come away with the radiator).

universal.zh: 車速慢或塞車時迎面風不夠，風扇把空氣抽過水箱。
universal.en: In slow traffic there is not enough ram air, so the fan pulls air through the radiator.

specific.zh: 這是 detachesWithParent=false 的示範：風扇要先單獨拆，水箱才拿得出來。
specific.en: This demonstrates detachesWithParent=false: the fan must come off on its own before the radiator can come out.

commonIssues.zh: 風扇馬達或控制模組故障：塞車時水溫升高、冷氣變弱。
commonIssues.en: Fan motor or controller failure: temperature climbs in traffic and A/C weakens.

name.zh: 機油濾芯座（含機油冷卻器）

universal.zh: 機油泵送出的油先經過濾芯把金屬屑濾掉，再去潤滑各處。濾芯是定期更換的耗材，和機油一起換。
universal.en: Oil from the pump passes through the filter to catch metal particles before lubricating the engine. The filter is a consumable, replaced with every oil change.

specific.zh: N20 用的是「濾紙芯」裝在鋁合金濾芯座裡，從上面轉開蓋子就能換，不用鑽到車底。濾芯座還整合了機油冷卻器，用冷卻水幫機油降溫。
specific.en: The N20 uses a cartridge filter in an aluminium housing; unscrew the cap from the top, no need to go under the car. The housing also integrates an oil cooler that uses engine coolant to cool the oil.

fasteners.desc: 濾芯座對缸體螺絲 / Housing-to-block bolts

warnings.zh: 拆濾芯座會同時流出機油和冷卻液，兩種都要接。
warnings.en: Removing the housing releases both oil and coolant; catch both.

commonIssues.zh: 濾芯座墊片老化漏油，機油從濾芯座下方流到皮帶上，是 N20 很常見的漏油點。
commonIssues.en: Housing gasket hardens and leaks; oil runs down onto the belt. One of the most common N20 leaks.

universal.zh: 紙質濾芯，濾掉機油裡的金屬屑和雜質，跟機油一起換。
universal.en: A paper element that strains metal and debris from the oil; changed with the oil.

specific.zh: N20 從引擎上方轉開濾芯蓋就能換。蓋子上的 O 型環要一起換。
specific.en: On the N20 it is changed from above by unscrewing the cap; replace the cap O-ring too.

warnings.zh: O 型環一次性。
warnings.en: The O-ring is single-use.

consequence.zh: 這台車機濾在引擎上方，不用拆底護板也拆得到；但放機油一定要拆底護板。
consequence.en: On this car the filter is on top of the engine, so the undertray can stay on; draining the oil, though, needs it off.

universal.zh: 一個小型熱交換器，讓冷卻液把機油溫度帶走。
universal.en: A small heat exchanger that lets coolant carry heat out of the oil.

specific.zh: N20 的機油冷卻器整合在機濾座上，跟著機濾座一起下來。
specific.en: On the N20 it is integrated into the filter housing and comes off with it.
